content.title: Chevron Amasses Largest Fleet in Almost a Year to Ship Venezuelan Oil
content.summary: Chevron has taken more oil after shipments by the so-called dark fleet vanished, following the US’s pledge to clamp down on illicit oil trading and Maduro’s ouster earlier this year.  The US also has enlisted traders Trafigura Group and Vitol Group to help sell as much as 50 million barrels of oil.  Chevron’s shipments are all bound for US refiners, including Valero Energy Corp. and Phillips 66.
